entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I'm... I'm a bit lost. I have this helmet I bought a while ago, and I think I need to send it back. The website was so confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, hang on... it's VF-8675309. I just... I don't really understand this whole process. It's overwhelming.
Not a problem at all, that's what I'm here for. I see the order for the VeloPro helmet. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh no, it's not broken. The box is still unopened. It’s just the color. It looked so much brighter online, and for safety, I really wanted a more visible color for the road. Can't you just help me?
I completely understand. Wanting to be visible is a very important part of bike safety. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Alright, I've pulled up your details. I see it was delivered 42 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for this helmet.
Oh, really? So I can send it back? I was so worried I missed the chance. That's such a relief.

Absolutely. Since the box is unopened and it's in its original condition, I can process that return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address we have on file. Do you still have access to that one?
Yes, I do! Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier.

You're very welcome. Just print the label, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
